name: transform-pipeline
description: resolveWithTrace over a transform on a page-state ref: add 3, an op the SDK does not know, then toString. The input is resolved first (its `state` step), then one `input` step (no `in`), then one step per known op, `in` the value before it and `out` the value after; the unknown op is skipped and records nothing. The static `by` of add records nothing.
